EnvironmentVariables.Comment: The following environment variables can be used for configuration:
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_BaseUrl: Base URL for the Terraform Registry
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_ModuleStoragePath: Local path to store modules (only required when StorageProvider is 'local')
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_Sqlite__ConnectionString: SQLite database connection string (e.g., Data Source=terraform.db)
EnvironmentVariables.TF_REG_AzureStorage__SasTokenExpiryMinut: Expiry time in minutes for SAS tokens
